The ManyChat Subscriber API, split by tag from the Swagger document ManyChat publishes at https://api.manychat.com/swagger (the underlying JSON is served from https://api.manychat.com/swagger/compileJson?type=Page_API). Authentication is an API key generated per page in Settings > API, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <page-id>:<api-key>`. Per-operation rate limits are published by ManyChat in each operation description. Operation IDs here are the readable API Evangelist refinement; the provider's generated hash ID is preserved on each operation as `x-provider-operation-id`.
